lines.text: Saul and Israel camped in the Valley of Elah, and Goliath of Gath came out from the Philistine camp.
Jesse had eight sons, and David, the youngest, went back and forth from Saul to tend sheep in Bethlehem.
Jesse sent David with roasted grain and ten loaves, and David left his supplies with the shepherd.
David took five smooth stones from the brook, and his sling stone struck Goliath on the chest.
Saul asked Abner whose son David was, and David said he was the son of Jesse of Bethlehem.
